reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in her #north-random thread to confirm the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June. Following her "no action needed", I didn't change anything else.

In a second reply, I told her:
- **The old date is still up:** I checked #north-team, and her post from this morning still says 25 November. My reply to that post says 25 November too.
- **Only this thread has the right date:** I can't save notes between conversations, so the 10 June date is recorded only in this #north-random thread. #north-random and #north-team don't have exactly the same members, so some of the team may not see it.
- **A fix is ready if she wants it:** I offered to post a short correction in #north-team. I'll only do that if she asks.
